record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare GEAR_GRIND: Klink (1 star, range 3), Klang (2 stars, range 3) and Klinklang (3 stars, range 3); all three have base speed 35, maxPP 100 and passive GEARS. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (factor table index). The GEARS passive is not covered, but it changes the caster speed that this ability reads.
record.summary: The caster launches two gears at the cast target: two delayed SPECIAL hits, the first at 0 ms and the second at 250 ms. Each hit's requested damage is round(caster speed x factor) with factor 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 for 1 / 2 / 3 stars (2 at 4 stars or fallback), where speed is read once at cast time, not per gear. AP and the cast crit flag apply inside handleSpecialDamage. Nothing else: no movement, status or buff.

targeting.who: the cast target, captured by reference for both gears
targeting.note: Single target; no retarget. The strategy has no hp check, so a gear that fires after the target died is simply absorbed by handleDamage's hp <= 0 guard (no damage).

effects.scaling: requested per gear = Math.round(pokemon.speed x factor), speed taken when the cast starts (one value for both gears; with base speed 35 the declared factors give 9 / 18 / 35 before rounding effects of speed changes, an arithmetic illustration of the table and not a combat result). Speed itself is a stat that addSpeed changes (clamped to 0..300) and the GEARS passive raises periodically. Applied by handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); if the cast crit, x 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor (Rocky Helmet cancels, Black Augurite reduces).
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: an hp <= 0 or resurrecting target takes nothing; attacker-state multipliers (enraged x2, electric / psychic / grass / fairy field x1.2, matching weather x1.2) apply first; SPECIAL damage is divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef; non-TRUE flat reductions; at least 1 per gear; shield before HP; protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target block a gear entirely. takenDamage includes shield damage.

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star factor 2 is not used by these units at factory values. All three declare the same base speed 35, so the star difference is only the factor. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond having a cast target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; each cast queues two independent commands and recomputes the speed-based damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: two hits of 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 x caster speed (rounded). Requested = round(speed x factor) using the speed at cast time; applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor if the cast crit), after attacker-state multipliers and divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef, minus flat reductions, minimum 1, per gear; takenDamage includes shield damage. Not computed for a specific target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, resurrection, other field multipliers); the attacker-state multiplier block, SPECIAL defence division, non-TRUE flat reductions and the minimum of 1 were located but not every modifier was traced
Crit resolution beyond the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the handleSpecialDamage multiplier
Whether a caster that dies mid-delay still runs the second queued gear (only the updateCommands loop was read, not every call site)
unresolved: The GEARS passive (class blocks in pokemon.ts, PassiveEffects entry in passives.ts) raises ally speed by 1 per interval after simulation start: how that, held items or other speed changes alter the cast-time speed was not traced beyond addSpeed
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
